description: Free. Every pump.fun launch after a moment in the last 24 hours, oldest first: each with its deployer's record before it (launches, graduations, seconds since its last launch) and the first-10-second bundle; launches newer than the hourly fill come within the minute (source live, bundle not yet read). For: what launched just now, new coins from devs with a record, watch new launches. Poll with t = next_since; call check_coin only for the coins worth a look.

t.description: unix seconds, within the last 24 hours; launches after it are listed. Left out: the last ten minutes

name: launches_since
